description: Field-confirmed calibration contract for PR2 CandidateDecision. Raw PCAP bytes are intentionally not committed; controlled hosts inject the file and must match SHA256 before evaluation.
calibration_notes: The Click candidate is approximately 9 ms after DTMF digit 6 onset; the local PCM spectrum is dominated near 770 Hz and 1477 Hz, consistent with digit 6.
Repository-style PCM_TX to downlink RTP correlation is approximately 0.899879 with +44 ms lag.
Equal-timestamp comparison makes two of eight silence windows appear active. Lag-aligned RTP source windows make all eight quiet/low-energy under PR2 thresholds.
This contract is a field regression checkpoint, not a substitute for the complete Lab Real + Field Confirmed production dataset.
